files.text:
title: "Fixture host project"

description:
  summary: >-
    A single MCP service, used by the true-bdd fixtures as the host
    project a scenario registry describes.

roles:
  - name: Operator
    definition: Runs the MCP service and watches what it answers.
  - name: Client Developer
    definition: Writes the clients that send the MCP service its requests.

glossary:
  - term: mcp service
    means: >-
      The service this project builds: it takes a message from a client
      and answers it. What every Scenario of the project observes.
  - term: reply
    means: >-
      What the MCP service sends back for one message, and how long it
      took to arrive. A client waits on it, so its content and its delay
      are both behaviour.
  - term: latency
    means: >-
      How long a reply takes to arrive, as the client's clock measures
      it: from the moment the client sends the message to the moment the
      reply arrives back at the client, in milliseconds.

concepts:
  given:
    - concept: service running
      means: The MCP service has started and accepts requests.
      terms: [mcp service]
  when:
    - concept: message sent
      means: A role sends a stated message to the MCP service, once.
      terms: [mcp service]
  then:
    - concept: answer
      means: The MCP service's reply to the message is exactly a stated text.
      terms: [mcp service, reply]
    - concept: reply time
      means: The latency of the MCP service's reply to the message is at most a stated number of milliseconds.
      terms: [mcp service, reply, latency]
